title: Kiang Yui

page_data.en:
G. I. S.
F. O. REG
432
6/7/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

5th July 1916.

Sir,
A small gun boat called "Kiang Yui" came up
the river from Woosung on 4th instant and is now
lying opposite the Arsenal.

Admiral Sah visited Lunghwa on the afternoon
of 4th instant, and had a long consultation with
General Yang. They have arranged to meet at the
same place again to-day, and Admiral Li of the
Navy has been requested to be present.

Sixty soldiers, who were sent to Pootung at
the time of the Chaoho trouble, returned to the
Arsenal on 4th instant. They are now quartered
in the Wenchow Guild.

Your obedient servant,

mmunulumsling
Chief Detective Inspector.

km
Captain Superintendent of Police.

AH
Enclosures. 11 & 2 copies.

G. I. S.
F. O. REG
432
6/7/16

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

1916年7月5日。

先生：

一艘名为“江瑞”（Kiang Yui）的小型炮艇于本月4日从吴淞溯江而上，目前停泊在兵工厂对面。

萨督军（Admiral Sah）于本月4日下午访问了龙华，并与杨将军进行了长时间磋商。他们已安排今日在同一地点再次会面，并已邀请海军李督军（Admiral Li）出席。

在查浩（Chaoho，音译）事件期间被派往浦东的六十名士兵，已于本月4日返回兵工厂。他们现驻扎在温州会馆。

您顺从的仆人，

mmunulumsling
首席侦探督察。

km
警务处总监。

AH
附件。11份及2份副本。
